text: すばやさの　たかい　ほうから　こうげきが　はじまるんだ！

structure.jp: すばやさの　たかい　ほうから
structure.en: starting from the one whose Speed is higher

structure.jp: こうげきが　はじまるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜ほう
patterns.span: すばやさの　たかい　ほう
patterns.explanation: ほう after a describing word picks out one side of two: 'the one that is more so'. の here does the job of が. すばやさの　たかい　ほう = 'the one whose Speed is higher'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives a tone of explaining how things are; ん is a short の. はじまるんだ = 'it begins, you see'.
